claim: Viral video purportedly shows Pakistani opposition MPs chanted ‘Modi, Modi’ (India's PM)  inside the Pakistani Parliament
justification: The claim is supported by multiple high-confidence evidence items. Key corroborated evidence from independent Pakistani news outlets (Geo News, ARY News) and fact-checkers confirms the authenticity of the viral video showing opposition MPs chanting 'Modi, Modi' inside the National Assembly in October 2020. Acoustic analysis verified the chant, and the incident was widely reported on October 28, 2020, aligning with the claim date. The low-confidence item about insufficient audio information is outweighed by these corroborated sources.
